title: Publication of data
previewText: The Department of City Planning shall make available, in a form easily accessed by the public, regularly updated calculations of the current Hudson Yards development parking supply, reservoir parking supply, spaces described in paragraphs (e)(2)(i) and (e)(2)(ii) of Section 93-821, and reservoir surplus or reservoir deficit, as applicable.
